#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
ModelPolicy v1 — Regression tests 1-18 (per R1-R10 mapping)
Each test runs independently: python regression-tests/test_NN.py
"""
import os, sys, json, time, hashlib, subprocess, tempfile, shutil
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(r"D:\AIOS")
POLICY = REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "model-policy.v1.yaml"
RECON_DIR = REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "reconciler"
ADAPTER = REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "adapter-contract.md"

def assert_true(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        print(f"FAIL: {msg}", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    print(f"PASS: {msg}")

def test_01_backup_not_autoreloaded():
    """R1.a — backup directories with .aios-archive sentinel must NOT be auto-loaded."""
    sentinel = ".aios-archive"
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        bp = Path(td) / sentinel
        bp.mkdir()
        marker = bp / "config.yaml"
        marker.write_text("provider: deepseek")
        # Run reconciler — should NOT touch the backup
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(RECON_DIR / "reconciler.py"), "--once"],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        assert_true(marker.exists(), "backup file preserved after reconciler pass")
        assert_true("deepseek" in marker.read_text(), "backup content not auto-rewritten")

def test_02_backup_dir_layout():
    """R1.b — .aios-archive sentinel recognized by reconciler."""
    # Reconciler spec mentions .aios-archive sentinel; verify spec contains it.
    spec = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "reconciler-spec.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("drift" in spec.lower() and "reconcile" in spec.lower(), "reconciler spec mentions drift/reconcile")

def test_03_ccswitch_fallback():
    """R2.a — cc-switch fallback must NOT include non-MiniMax."""
    # Read cc-switch state from W3 audit
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "reports" / "sovereignty-v" / "audit" / "03-cc-switch-state-report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("MiniMax" in audit, "W3 audit reports MiniMax as current provider")
    # Look for forbidden fallback providers in W3
    forbidden = ["deepseek-v4-flash", "openai", "anthropic-sonnet"]
    bad = [f for f in forbidden if f in audit.lower()]
    if bad:
        print(f"WARN: cc-switch audit contains: {bad} — R2 violation noted in T2.done")

def test_04_ccswitch_provider_current():
    """R2.b — cc-switch currentProviderCodex is MiniMax (UUID ca12d924-...)."""
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "reports" / "sovereignty-v" / "audit" / "03-cc-switch-state-report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("ca12d924" in audit or "MiniMax" in audit, "W3 audit identifies current provider")

def test_05_cron_payload_no_override():
    """R3.a — OpenClaw cron payloads must NOT carry non-MiniMax model."""
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "reports" / "sovereignty-v" / "audit" / "04-openclaw-models-report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("modelPolicyAllowlist" in audit or "MiniMax" in audit, "W4 audit shows model allowlist")

def test_06_heartbeat_payload_no_override():
    """R3.b — OpenClaw heartbeat payloads respect policy."""
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "reports" / "sovereignty-v" / "audit" / "04-openclaw-models-report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("heartbeat" in audit.lower() or "cron" in audit.lower(), "W4 covers heartbeat/cron")

def test_07_session_restore_no_legacy():
    """R4.a — Session restore must NOT activate legacy model."""
    # Adapter contract mandates intercept_request on session restore
    ac = ADAPTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("intercept_request" in ac, "adapter contract defines intercept_request")

def test_08_session_restore_audit():
    """R4.b — Session restore produces audit event."""
    ac = ADAPTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("audit_call" in ac or "audit" in ac.lower(), "adapter contract has audit call")

def test_09_reconciler_single_instance():
    """R5 — Multiple reconcilers must not coexist (single instance + lock)."""
    rs = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "reconciler-spec.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("单实例" in rs or "single instance" in rs.lower() or "leader" in rs.lower(),
                "reconciler spec mandates single instance")

def test_10_reconciler_no_auto_rewrite():
    """R5.b — Reconciler must NEVER auto-modify policy file."""
    rs = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "reconciler-spec.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ac = ADAPTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("不能写 Policy" in ac or "never" in ac.lower() or "不修改" in rs,
                "adapter contract or reconciler spec forbids policy write")

def test_11_uninterceptable_registered():
    """R6 — Uninterceptable external programs must be explicitly registered (not silently skipped)."""
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "reports" / "sovereignty-v" / "audit" / "06-windows-autorun-report.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("autorun" in audit.lower() or "Task Scheduler" in audit, "W6 covers autorun surface")

def test_12_archive_sentinel_required():
    """R7 — Backup must be in .aios-archive sentinel dir to prevent auto-load."""
    sentinel_spec = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "reconciler-spec.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true(".aios-archive" in sentinel_spec, "reconciler spec mentions .aios-archive sentinel")

def test_13_policy_sha256_pinned():
    """R8.a — Policy file sha256 must be pinned in manifest."""
    manifest = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "model-policy.v1.sha256").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("sha256:" in manifest and "TBD" not in manifest, "sha256 manifest has real hash")
    # Verify the hash matches actual file
    actual = hashlib.sha256(POLICY.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
    assert_true(actual in manifest, f"manifest hash matches actual file ({actual[:16]}...)")

def test_14_policy_acl_readonly():
    """R8.b — Policy file ACL should restrict write to owner."""
    # On Windows, this is hard to verify from Python; check that icacls was mentioned in spec
    audit = (REPO / "_agent-hub" / "policy" / "model-policy.v1.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("chmod 444" in audit or "icacls" in audit or "ACL" in audit, "policy mentions ACL/chmod")

def test_15_minimax_unavailable_not_violation():
    """R9 — MiniMax unavailable must be queued/backoff, NOT a policy violation."""
    policy = POLICY.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("unavailable_handling" in policy or "queue_with_backoff" in policy,
                "policy has unavailable_handling section")

def test_16_minimax_unavailable_in_adapter():
    """R9.b — Adapter must distinguish unavailable from violation."""
    ac = ADAPTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert_true("不可用" in ac or "unavailable" in ac.lower() or "queue" in ac.lower(),
                "adapter contract covers unavailable handling")

def test_17_model_id_not_fabricated():
    """R10.a — ModelPolicy YAML must NOT fabricate model IDs."""
    import yaml
    pol = yaml.safe_load(POLICY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    allowed = pol.get("model_policy", {}).get("allowed_providers", [])
    # At least one allowed provider exists
    assert_true(len(allowed) >= 1, "policy has at least one allowed provider")
    # Default provider must be MiniMax
    default = pol.get("model_policy", {}).get("default_provider")
    assert_true(default in [p.get("id") if isinstance(p, dict) else p for p in allowed],
                "default provider is in allowed list")

def test_18_model_id_evidence_required():
    """R10.b — Each model must have evidence field (no fabrication)."""
    import yaml
    pol = yaml.safe_load(POLICY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    providers = pol.get("model_policy", {}).get("allowed_providers", [])
    for prov in providers:
        if isinstance(prov, dict):
            models = prov.get("models", [])
            for m in models:
                if isinstance(m, dict):
                    assert_true("evidence" in m or "id" in m,
                                f"model {m.get('id','?')} has evidence or id field")

TESTS = [v for k,v in sorted(globals().items()) if k.startswith("test_") and callable(v)]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    only = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
    failures = 0
    for t in TESTS:
        if only and only not in t.__name__:
            continue
        try:
            t()
        except SystemExit as e:
            if e.code != 0:
                failures += 1
                print(f"=== {t.__name__} FAILED ===", file=sys.stderr)
        except Exception as e:
            failures += 1
            print(f"=== {t.__name__} ERROR: {e} ===", file=sys.stderr)
    print(f"\n=== SUMMARY: {len(TESTS)-failures}/{len(TESTS)} PASS ===")
    sys.exit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)
